review_type: independent static source and contract review; root-owned test evidence inspected separately

observation_mask.contract: Use memory_write_mask when provided as the history observation boundary, otherwise validity mask. Require observed_mask to be a subset of validity and reject malformed masks. Selected target and padding are zeroed BEFORE cumulative sums. Each query uses its OWN causal prefix span and rank, never final-window span.
observation_mask.implementation: causal_elapsed_age_geometry rejects observed positions outside validity before cumulative arithmetic; canonical target_outputs supplies a valid subset.

beta_activity.contract: The [2,4] beta tensor has finite strictly positive L2 distance from its all-zero initialization, and corresponding AdamW exp_avg/exp_avg_sq tensors are finite with positive norms and positive step. At least one element must move; all eight need not be nonzero.
beta_activity.implementation: Full-e1 audit requires finite beta and AdamW moment tensors with at least one nonzero entry and the full train-batch step count; it does not require all eight coefficients to move.

static_checks.detail: Signed query-prefix elapsed-age minus rank-age geometry is added after scaled QK and before masks/softmax. First boundary gap, non-observed pairs and persistent columns have no new bias. Existing J relationship and per-query prefix logic were reviewed previously and remain unchanged.

Zero beta construction consumes no RNG; beta times geometry stays on the gradient graph. Optional bias None preserves original call paths. Casting occurs to the existing attention score dtype, with persistent columns padded on the left.

static_checks.area: Factory and real CLI training path
static_checks.detail: Dedicated backbone and role register together; direct log-MSE, legacy time head and no tail loss are enforced. Candidate CLI uses filtered train/validation materialization, the existing optimizer/loss/selector, and explicit observed-target boundaries.

New route metadata and finite beta/key/value shapes are validated before legacy key-value routing; relabelled candidate states and cross-loading are rejected. Existing candidate output directories fail before training, including forced rerun requests. State restoration uses strict load_state_dict.

Packager exports committed git archive source, rejects tracked source drift, checks required source/frozen references, disallows links/special files, and emits per-file hashes. E1 runner verifies runtime/source/data, requires CUDA test XML without failures/errors/skips, executes Taxi then Instacart, and does not retry or resume.

Audit checks full train batch counts and train target statistics, exact validation strata/counts, finite model/optimizer state, beta activity, source identities, best/last checkpoint consistency, peak CUDA memory and held-out absence. E1 completion does not evaluate the prospective performance adoption gate.

Synthetic e1 test invokes the actual CLI/train path on temporary train/validation data with a held-out poison sentinel; synthetic hashes/counts are deliberately substituted and do not validate production data. h64 training-shape tests use B2 locally and B128 under CUDA for L64/L256. CUDA float16/bfloat16 and next-step replay remain required server checks.

root_owned_test_evidence.source: Root integrated local pytest run; reviewer read completed log and JUnit XML only

pending_authorized_checks: 5090 runtime/GPU/data/source preflight and isolated committed-source transfer
CUDA contracts including actual B128 h64 L64/L256 and supported autocast, with zero skipped tests
Fresh full Taxi and Instacart e1 plus independent output audit
performance_and_authorization: No performance adoption, e300 screening, new seeds/datasets, held-out evaluation, push or service/runtime change is established or authorized by this review.
